d11dc27194b4720d.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards. 

Great creative production feels a lot like that.

Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make.

We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again.

You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets.

In this role, you’ll:

• Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives.

• Personally lead our most ambitious campaigns and selected projects from concept through delivery across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated work.

• Partner with creative leaders to turn ambitious ideas into production plans that hold up against timing, budget, and reality, challenging underdeveloped briefs and protecting the creative idea through execution.

• Build and lead an exceptional network of agencies, directors, studios, photographers, freelancers, and production partners that expands our capacity without lowering the bar.

• Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable.

• Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks.

• Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry.

What you’ll bring:

• Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects.

• Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea.

• Strong financial and operational judgment, including experience with scoping, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and managing meaningful production investments.

• A track record of building production systems, capabilities, or ways of working, not simply operating within established ones.

• Experience building and managing an exceptional network of agencies, production companies, directors, studios, freelancers, and vendors.

• Strong creative judgment and the confidence to challenge briefs, protect ambitious ideas, and make difficult tradeoffs without losing sight of the work.

• Exceptional communication and partnership skills across creative teams, marketers, executives, and external partners.

• The ability to bring calm, clarity, and sound judgment to ambiguity. You're excited to build the function from the ground up and still want to personally produce the work.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. d12874e03587e57e.description: Product Manager (GenAI & Enterprise Software) Company: Techdome Job Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India Employment Type: Full-time Experience Required: 3+ years Anyone can build a GenAI demo in a weekend. Making it work for real users, inside enterprise constraints, on a real deadline and budget, is where products are won. As our Product Manager for GenAI and Enterprise Software, thats your job. Company Description At Techdome, we build AI-first products for enterprise clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists are excellent. We need a PM who turns that talent into shipped products: someone who catches the unclear requirement, the dropped handoff, and the unspoken risk before they become delays. The Role in One Line You own each product from the first client conversation to launch and beyond: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the client relationship. What Youll Work On Your portfolio will blend two worlds. On the GenAI side: LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous AI agents, and end-to-end workflow automation. On the enterprise side: scalable software platforms with integrations, security, and compliance requirements to match. Every product has to launch on time, stay within budget, and move the metrics our clients care about. What Youll Do Shape the product: Turn client vision into clear scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are ambitious but grounded in technical reality. Keep teams in sync: Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are clean and nothing is left to assumption. Take GenAI from demo to production: Work with ML engineers to make prototypes reliable, scalable, and safe, with attention to accuracy, latency, evaluation, and cost per query. Bridge GenAI and enterprise needs: Fit AI features into client systems through APIs and integrations, while meeting enterprise expectations for security, data privacy, and uptime. Become fluent in the clients world: Learn their industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and convert them into requirements the team can build without guesswork. Lead people and partners: Plan team capacity, manage third-party vendors (including LLM and cloud providers), and hold everyone to clear commitments. Raise risks early: Run structured change control and flag delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks (privacy, bias, hallucinations, prompt injection, runaway costs) while theyre still cheap to fix. Report honestly: Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates. Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: You learn our delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.By 60 days: You independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.By 90 days: Youve delivered a key milestone, improved how we run projects, and earned the trust of your team and clients. What You Bring Must have 3+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having shipped at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a clear grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOpsWorking knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana Technical grounding in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to challenge estimates and earn engineers respect Strong judgment in managing risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders Nice to have Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practicesPMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification Deep expertise in a specific industry, especially FinTech or Healthcare Exposure to multiple domains, and the curiosity to learn a new one fast Why Techdome Hard problems worth solving: Technically demanding, GenAI-driven projects across industries. People who raise your game: Work daily with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.A real seat at the table: Help shape how projects are planned, run, and delivered, rather than following a playbook someone else wrote. Growth at the edge of GenAI: Build deep expertise in one of techs fastest-moving fields. .

d163e789a9242c48.description: ### Product Engineer ### What [Novyte Materials](https://novyte.ai) does * We're building an AI-powered materials discovery platform. Think of it as giving research scientists a copilot that accelerates how new materials are identified, tested, and brought to production. * Our stack combines PyTorch Bayesian models, AI agents, LLM toolchains, a FastAPI backend, and a React + Tailwind frontend. * We're backed by Theia Ventures, working with real enterprise customers and real scientists, and shipping software that runs on sensitive on-prem GPU infrastructure. ### Why this role exists * [Our platform](https://novyte.ai/q) is moving into enterprise deployments, and the product has to keep up. Ideas are coming from everywhere: the AI research team, the design team, our customers, and our own daily use of the product. We need someone who turns those ideas into polished, reliable software. * You'll own features end-to-end, from the React UI to the FastAPI endpoint to the database underneath. This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. You'll be building from scratch alongside a small, technically sharp team. ### What you'll actually do * Ship features across the full product: React/Tailwind frontend, FastAPI backend, and Postgres/MongoDB data layers. * Turn research into product. When the AI team has a new Bayesian model, agent workflow, or LLM toolchain, you make it something a scientist can actually use and trust. * Work closely with design and implement their vision **exactly**, down to the details that make a tool feel great. * Take product ideas from the team, scope them, build them, and improve them after launch. * Design clean APIs and data models, and keep queries fast as data and customers grow. * Keep our GitHub Actions pipelines healthy and make light infrastructure changes on AWS/GCP when features need them, so the software team ships confidently and often. * Build with both deployment modes in mind: cloud and **on-prem/air-gapped installs** where there's no internet to fall back on. ### What we're looking for * Someone who loves implementing ideas *perfectly*, with strong instincts for UX, edge cases, and "this doesn't feel right yet." * Strong React and modern frontend fundamentals, and comfort with Tailwind. * Solid Python/FastAPI experience: you can design and ship backend services, not just call them. * Comfortable with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including schema design and query performance. * Working knowledge of GitHub Actions and AWS and/or GCP. You don't need to be an infra expert, just able to keep up. * SSH and Linux knowledge is a nice-to-have. The terminal should at least not scare you. * You don't need to check every box. We care more about someone who figures things out and takes ownership than someone with a perfect résumé. ### Why join now * You'd be early enough to shape the product and the codebase. No legacy systems to inherit. * You'll work at the intersection of AI research and product, turning cutting-edge models and agents into software scientists use daily. * The team is small, technically strong, and building something with genuine scientific impact. * The product is just the start. We have multiple platforms to build, spanning everything from designing perfect polymers to drug discovery to simulating the physics of the chemical world to generate entirely new, undiscovered materials.

d14b9388ba6f208b.description: ## **About Bureau** Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally. Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond. ## **Why Bureau?** Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading. **What You'll Do** - Build and maintain features and components for graph-native models (GNNs, embeddings, graph algorithms) used to detect fraud, collusion, and identity risk - Support the design, training, and evaluation of statistical, AI/ML, and deep learning models for fraud and risk, under a senior data scientist's guidance - Run experiments, clean and prepare data, and do light pipeline work to help tune model performance - Write production-quality code backed by statistics and ML, and help build out ML observability for the models you work on - Document your work clearly enough that others on the team can pick it up **What You'll Bring** - BS/MS in ML, CS, Math, Stats, or a related field; 1 to 3 years in DS/AI/ML Engineering roles (internships with real shipped work count) - Strong Python; working knowledge of SQL; exposure to a cloud platform (AWS/Databricks/Azure) is a plus - Some experience taking a model from a notebook toward something production-adjacent, ideally with fraud, risk, payments, or compliance data — but we'll take strong fundamentals over domain experience - Comfort with ambiguity and unlabelled data, and the initiative to ask questions and look things up rather than wait to be told - Prior exposure to graph-based thinking (even coursework or personal projects) is a plus, not a requirement ## **Our Culture** - We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way - We value performance, not hours worked - Speed, ownership, and impact matter most ## **Compensation** - Competitive salary + potential equity - Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

Headquarters: Remote, USA

About the role

We're hiring for a Senior Manager, Global Workforce Planning & Transformation to help scale and optimize workforce planning across our global Customer Operations organization. Delivering exceptional member experiences requires having the right people in the right place at the right time, and this role sits at the center of making that happen.

As our Senior Manager, Global Workforce Management, you'll lead a team responsible for forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and workforce optimization for an operation supporting more than 4,000 agents globally. You'll partner closely with Operations, Finance, Vendor Management, Analytics, and Technology teams to improve operational performance while helping shape the future of workforce management through AI, automation, and continuous innovation.

In this role, you can expect to

• Lead forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and workforce optimization activities across a large-scale global customer operations organization supporting more than 4,000 agents.

• Develop staffing plans that align member demand, service level objectives, employee experience, and financial goals.

• Partner with Operations, Finance, Vendor Management, and Analytics teams to ensure workforce strategies support business priorities and long-term growth.

• Monitor workforce performance, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend staffing adjustments that improve operational outcomes.

• Establish and enhance processes that improve forecast accuracy, staffing efficiency, schedule effectiveness, and workforce performance.

• Champion AI, automation, and emerging workforce technologies to improve scalability, forecasting precision, and operational decision-making.

• Manage, coach, and develop a high-performing workforce management team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 7+ years of workforce management experience supporting large-scale customer operations environments.

• 3+ years of people leadership experience with a demonstrated track record of coaching, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Deep expertise in forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management, and workforce analytics that drive measurable business outcomes.

• Experience supporting complex operations with thousands of agents across multiple geographies, channels, and outsourced vendor partners.

• Strong analytical skills and experience translating workforce data into actionable recommendations for operational and executive stakeholders.

• Experience driving process improvements, operational efficiencies, and cross-functional initiatives that improve service delivery and business performance.

• Passion for leveraging AI, automation, predictive analytics, and workforce technologies to modernize workforce management practices and improve decision-making.
